milestone_full: Layer S continues: 186 Hong Kong chapters in three arms, atlas lockstep 186/186/186 with a derived fence. The ticket arc (179-183), the crossing arc (64-67) and chapter 186 — the first bus carries the ticket away at 06:10 — make the world walkable in both directions. A measured world census states the real size, two deterministic re-entry doors end the old 106-chapter dead end, and the primary hub now renders a derived eight-chapter continuation rail. A browser pass in both locales found and fixed 12 React duplicate-key errors. Production-limit siege: 2,702 credential-stuffing requests ALL 429 at p50=25 ms, zero 5xx, read plane 244/244. Spring Cloud edge, 12 StateGraph lanes, admin behavior analytics (password 123) with a real funnel, embedded in-app handbook, contract-enforced English arm. D1577 removed the Clash Verge dependency; all outbound lanes use direct egress by default. The gpt-6.2-sol API is closed by directive. verify_all NO OFFENDER, 1016 web + 38k AI green.
headline: 186 Hong Kong chapters in three arms · atlas lockstep 186/186/186 · two curated arcs, measured census and a hub continuation rail · browser-verified bilingual UI · production siege 2,702 ALL 429, zero 5xx · Spring Cloud + 12 StateGraph lanes · admin funnel · Clash-free egress · 1016 web + 38k AI green · LLM API closed.
features: D1584: browser-verified /hong-kong in both locales — rail and 8 cards intact, zero console errors after fixing 12 duplicate-key React warnings.
D1583: chapter 186 — at 06:10 the first bus carries the ticket away; the arc reaches 186 with atlas lockstep 186/186/186.
D1580/D1581: the primary hub offers a derived eight-chapter continuation rail beyond the 106-chapter curated clock, and the in-app handbook teaches it in both arms.
D1577/1578: no Clash Verge dependency — LLM, embedding and Wikipedia-facts lanes use direct egress; a proxy is explicit opt-in only.
D1570/D1569: the behavior funnel and reader profiles reach parity on the live route, not just the demo payload.
D1567/D1563: two curated arcs — the ticket arc (179-183) and the crossing arc (64-67) — walkable from any chapter, server-rendered, locale-derived titles.
D1541: siege re-measured at PRODUCTION limits — 2,702 stuffing requests ALL 429 at p50=25 ms; read plane 244/244, zero 5xx.
privacy_note: All consumer fixtures are synthetic (demo flags); no real merchant, stall or operator is represented. /insights replay is deterministic synthetic inference, not stored user data. All REAL-HK figures are public sources with URLs inline on the handbook page.
milestone_full_zh: Layer S 持續：186 章香港系列三語臂，圖譜鎖步 186/186/186，圍欄由索引推導。票之弧（179–183）、渡之弧（64–67）與第 186 章（06:10 頭班車把票帶走）讓世界可雙向行走；世界普查實測規模、確定性再入門結束舊有 106 章死胡同，主站現在渲染由語料派生的八章續走軌道。雙語瀏覽器實測找出並修好 12 個 React 重複 key 報錯。生產級攻城：2,702 發撞庫全部 429（p50=25ms、零 5xx），讀面 244/244。Spring Cloud 邊緣、12 條 StateGraph、密碼 123 管理員漏斗、嵌入式說明書、契約強制英文臂。D1577 移除 Clash Verge 依賴，出站默認直連；gpt-6.2-sol API 已按指令關閉。verify_all 全綠，web 1016＋AI 38k 全綠。
headline_zh: 186 章香港系列三語臂 · 圖譜鎖步 186/186/186 · 兩條策展弧、世界普查與主站續走軌道 · 雙語瀏覽器實測 · 攻城 2,702 發全數 429、零 5xx · Spring Cloud＋12 條 StateGraph · 管理員漏斗 · 脫離 Clash 直連 · 1016 web＋38k AI 全綠 · 大模型 API 已關閉。
features_zh: D1584：雙語瀏覽器實測 /hong-kong——續走軌道與 8 張卡完整，修好 12 個重複 key 報錯後控制台零錯。
D1580／D1581：主站在 106 章時辰表之後提供由語料派生的八章續走軌道，內嵌說明書兩語臂都有教。
D1577／1578：移除 Clash Verge 依賴——LLM、向量與維基資料通道全部直連，代理僅為顯式可選項。
D1570／D1569：行為漏斗與讀者畫像在 live 路徑與 demo 載荷對等。
D1567／D1563：兩條策展弧——票之弧（179–183）與渡之弧（64–67）——可從任一章走完，服務端渲染、標題隨語言推導。
D1541：以生產級限流重測攻城——2,702 發撞庫全數 429（p50=25ms）；讀面 244/244，零 5xx。
